submitted.rationale: XRD shows index 0 (Bi0.27Cu0.26V0.47) is mostly monoclinic BiVO4 (Q≈2.035, 1.346), with a Cu-vanadate secondary phase and FTO substrate peaks (1.878, 2.653). Among the three merit measurements it gave the highest photocurrent at 2.4 eV: 1.39 µA. The Bi-rich point, index 6, gave 0.12 µA. The more Cu/V-rich point, index 1, gave 0.97 µA. This suggests a peak near index 0 along the V-rich edge.

rejected.reason: Measured 0.12 µA. It is Bi-rich, and XRD shows extra CuBi2O4/Cu-oxide peaks.
Measured 0.97 µA, which is lower than index 0. Adding more Cu and removing Bi past index 0 reduces photocurrent.
XRD shows Cu-rich CuO/Cu-vanadate phases and little BiVO4, so it was not measured.
XRD shows the Bi-rich CuBi2O4-type phase, which is a poor photoanode, so it was not measured.
